description: Na₂AgAlF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent AgF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.98 Å. Ag is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-F bond lengths are 2.37 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.82 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na, one Ag, and one Al atom.
